sp500.csv.source: FRED series SP500 (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

crypto_top15.csv.source: Binance Public Spot Klines (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, ADA, AVAX, DOGE, DOT, LINK, MATIC, NEAR, ATOM, UNI, LTC)
crypto_top15.csv.coverage: 2021-01-01 to 2023-12-31 (daily closes + Order Flow Imbalance (OFI), 15 synchronized assets + composite)
features: 15 asset Order Flow Imbalances (OFI = (V_buy - V_sell) / V_total)
crypto_top15.csv.license_note: Binance public market data terms apply

crypto_top15_orderflow.csv.coverage: 2021-01-01 to 2023-12-31 (daily volume, aggressive taker buy volume, taker sell volume, OFI)
crypto_top15_orderflow.csv.license_note: Binance public market data terms apply

equity_top15.csv.source: Yahoo Finance Public Daily Bars (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, META, TSLA, JPM, V, JNJ, WMT, PG, XOM, UNH, SPY)
equity_top15.csv.coverage: 2021-01-04 to 2023-12-29 (753 synchronized trading days, close, high, low, volume, proxy OFI, taker buy proxy)

multi_asset_30_orderflow.csv.source: Synchronized Cross-Asset Panel (15 Cryptocurrencies + 15 US Mega-Cap Equities)
multi_asset_30_orderflow.csv.coverage: 2021-01-04 to 2023-12-29 (753 trading days, 30 assets, 22,590 asset-day records)

multi_asset_90_5yr_orderflow.csv.source: Synchronized Cross-Asset Panel (45 Cryptocurrencies + 45 US Equities, Sector ETFs & Macro Assets)
